mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI index increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in employment growth signal a deteriorating labor market, triggering recession fears that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A housing construction boom, indicated by rising new home starts, signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average by 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production growth signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% signals economic stagnation, reducing corporate profit expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where GDPC1 quarterly growth falls below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO monthly change falls below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales index signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS rises for 3 consecutive months.
